description: This file contains the implementation of the 'convert lead' web service functionality in a CRM system, including lead conversion logic, related entity creation, data population, validation, and status updates.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Class representing a web service object, used for obtaining handler paths and classes for CRM modules.

methods.name: vtws_convertlead
methods.description: Performs the conversion of a lead into other CRM entities such as Accounts, Contacts, and Potentials, handling creation or linking of entities, transfer of related records, and updating lead status.

methods.name: vtws_populateConvertLeadEntities
methods.description: Populates entity fields with lead information, applying mappings and default values for mandatory fields.

methods.name: vtws_validateConvertLeadEntityMandatoryValues
methods.description: Ensures all mandatory fields are populated in an entity before creation, assigning default or placeholder values where necessary.

methods.name: vtws_getConvertLeadFieldInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a specific lead conversion field within a module.

methods.name: vtws_convertLeadTransferHandler
methods.description: Handles transfer of related records during lead conversion, wrapping the transfer logic with exception handling.

methods.name: vtws_updateConvertLeadStatus
methods.description: Updates the lead record to mark it as converted and cleans up related records.
